claims.text: East of the Great Court, forming the western boundary of the Hypostyle Hall.
Horemheb extended the temple westward with this gateway. Its role changed from external entrance to boundary of the later columned hall.
Ramesses I replaced Horemheb’s cartouches; a name on a gateway therefore need not identify its original builder.

caveats: Present access, exact viewpoints and condition have not been field-verified.
